subject.title: [Feature]: Feature Request: Batch Tool Calls + Context Block Management + Plan Enforcement

question: Should OpenClaw pursue this umbrella as core native APIs, split it into narrower maintainer-reviewed tracks, or defer it behind existing plugin/context primitives?
rationale: The request adds native tool schemas, local context lifecycle semantics, config surface, and runner enforcement policy; source inspection confirms adjacent primitives exist but do not settle the desired product contract.

options.title: Split Into Design Tracks
options.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella and require separate maintainer-approved designs for batching, context lifecycle, and plan enforcement before implementation.

options.title: Narrow To Context Lifecycle
options.body: Move the active work to the narrower context-clear/archive tracker and leave batching and plan enforcement for future proposals.

options.title: Defer Core Work
options.body: Treat existing `update_plan`, context pruning, context-engine hooks, and plugin/search-provider options as sufficient for now and close only after an explicit maintainer decision.

recommendation.title: Split Into Design Tracks
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella and require separate maintainer-approved designs for batching, context lifecycle, and plan enforcement before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete appears in history for the adjacent structured planning, cache-TTL pruning, and runtime parameter surfaces, and also participated in this issue's maintainer-facing discussion.
